messages.author: 11c9f8eed87b3505
messages.subject: Question about selectize ajax
parts:
Hello,

In the selectize example application, there is one selectizeInput, which uses the github API. See here: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/blob/master/013-selectize/ui.R#L74

This behavior is neat for reasons I will explain below, but I wish there was a more straight forward way to implement this behavior from the server.

What is optimal about the way selectize works here is that it reexecutes its query each time the input changes.

Suppose I have selectizeInput with its choices defined by a reactive value in the server i.e.

# in ui.R 
selectizeInput('foo', choices = NULL, ...) 
# in server.R
data <- reactive({*some DBI query*})
observe({updateSelectizeInput(session, 'foo', choices = data(), server = TRUE)})

This won't behave like the github example unless I can find a way to reexecute the reactive each time the user selects the selectizeInput or enters a value into it.

I have a use case where the values for my selectizeInput change very quickly so I want the query that provides the values for the selectizeInput to reexecute each time the user accesses the selectizeInput.

My first guess is something along the lines of replacing the $.ajax call with this: https://github.com/daattali/advanced-shiny/tree/master/api-ajax

Another idea I had was to use plumber to create an ad hoc API and make the $.ajax calls with that, but that seems not ideal.

Before I jump down this rabbit hole I was curious if others have dealt with this problem in a clean way.

Kind Regards,
Carl Ganz

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Question about selectize ajax
parts:
We have a built in feature in Shiny for making targets for ajax calls inside of a session, called registerDataObj; it's how updateSelectizeInput(server=TRUE) is implemented. You can study this code and write your own version of updateSelectizeInput to hook up custom logic.

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/blob/d62a2fc1d5981d652939199f832386359de90280/R/update-input.R#L625-L694

There is a little bit of documentation on registerDataObj at ?session.
